name: Deep Descent
desc:
You have been forcefully recruited by the company to recover the remains of the previous research vessel, while descending you notice that you are not alone.. team up with others and survive the unfortunate and deadly journey. Explore the depths and regain your lost freedom.

Descension soon.. Happy descent :)

Be sure to 👍 Like the game and 📩 Join the group to support us!

Available on PC/Mobile, Console , VR Support soon.
